evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence as a commodity subject to property and cost distinctions — proportionality and price logic, not shared identity or hierarchy.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' performs market-pricing: it locates value in what is retained versus what is commoditized, a cost-benefit framing of relational holding.
